prepaid.autopay_rule: Auto Pay discount of $10/mo on plans $45 & higher after the 1st month. $5/mo discount on the $35 Talk & Text plan after the 1st month. Credit or Debit card required. Additional loyalty discounts do not apply.
prepaid.loyalty_rule: Loyalty discount of $5/mo applies after 3 months of service; additional $5/mo applies after 9 months of service, for a total of $10/mo on plans $45 or higher. Discount applies as long as your line is not disconnected. Additional Auto Pay discounts do not apply.
prepaid.multiline_rule: Save $20/mo when you add any Verizon Prepaid Unlimited phone plan to your Multiline account. Each additional Unlimited phone line receives a $20/mo discount. Auto Pay and loyalty discounts cannot be combined.
prepaid.price_lock: Applies to the then-current base monthly rate charged by Verizon for your talk, text and data; excludes taxes, fees, surcharges, one-time charges, additional plan discounts or promotions and third-party services. Price guarantee is void if lines are canceled or moved to an ineligible plan.
